text:
The customer received the wrong power adapter with their replacement hub (order LM-46855) and experienced repeated transfers and unfulfilled promises over three previous calls. They want the correct adapter sent out, a non-templated written apology, and assurance that they won't have to repeat this experience in the future. 

So far, the previous agent has dispatched the correct adapter (tracking LMT-5521-014-IN) and added a history note to the customer's account to prevent future repetition. Next, that agent needs to send the promised personal written apology via email, and the customer will await delivery of the adapter.
